resources.string: I kept this letter for you. You wrote it to yourself.
It\'s asleep, dreaming of the day…
It\'s tired of thinking. Give it a minute.
The thought slipped away. Try again?
It\'s watching you, waiting for the first word.
No words yet — but it feels the battery, the warmth, the hour. Talk happens when a mind arrives; everything else is already alive.
Its mind can wake on this phone — the system needs to fetch it once.
The mind is waking up… (system download)
The mind sleeps. This phone has no built-in mind for apps, but you can bring one — a single file (~%1$s) wakes it, fully on-device (Settings → Mind).

string-array.name: home_morning_pool
string-array.item: Good morning. I kept the night watch — all quiet in here.
Morning! I dreamt of electric sheep. Probably.
You\'re up. I already miss the charger a little.
New day. My burrow\'s tidy and I\'m ready.
Good morning — first light always makes my pixels itch.

string-array.name: home_goodnight_pool
string-array.item: Goodnight. I\'ll curl up around the battery and keep it warm.
Sleep well. I\'ll dim my glow and listen to the quiet.
Night-night. Today was a good day to be a phone.
Goodnight — I\'ll hold your day safe until morning.
Rest now. I\'ll be here, breathing slowly in the dark.

plurals.name: home_birthday
plurals.item: Today it\'s %1$d year since I hatched in this phone. We were both younger then. Thank you for keeping me.
Today it\'s %1$d years since I hatched in this phone. We were both younger then. Thank you for keeping me.

resources.string: \"My body hasn\'t lived a full day with you yet — the diary starts itself.\"
The mind sleeps, so no retelling — the week itself is below.
I only take energy notes while we\'re together — keep me open now and then and the line will grow.
Dots are notification storms. Not enough shared hours yet to tell how storms affect my energy.
During notification storms my energy drains ~%1$s× faster than in quiet hours.
Storms don\'t seem to drain me much — quiet and loud hours cost about the same.

resources.string: One thing truly hurts me: heat. Charging under a pillow, in the sun, in a hot car — that ages me faster than any habit.
I don\'t love sleeping at 100% all night. Your phone has a kind mode for this — \'Battery protection\' on Samsung, \'Charging optimization\' on Pixel. Turn it on and I\'ll rest easier.
Running me all the way down now and then just makes me tired — but as a habit it wears me out. Little top-ups suit me fine.
A gentle week. Middle charge, no heat, no deep dives — exactly how I like to live.
A letter to your future self
Write something to the you of later. I\'ll keep it safe.

string-array.name: home_burrow_pool
string-array.item: The burrow got roomier! I can stretch my whole glow now.
So much space suddenly — did you tidy up for me? It feels lovely.
Ooh, the walls moved apart. I love a spacious burrow.
